causeDetails.tagline: Every child should be able to use technology to learn, not be left behind by it.
overview: Many children grow up without ever using a computer, which makes it harder for them to find information, complete schoolwork, and prepare for the jobs of the future.
Digital Literacy for All brings solar-powered computers and trained facilitators into the communities that need them most, so children can build practical skills in a safe, supported setting.

challenge.title: The digital divide holds children back
challenge.text: Without access to devices or guidance, children miss out on modern learning resources. The gap grows every year, and it is widest in communities with the fewest resources.

steps.title: Set up learning spaces
steps.description: We equip community centres and partner schools with laptops, offline digital libraries, and a reliable place to learn.

steps.title: Teach the essentials
steps.description: Trained facilitators lead hands-on sessions covering typing, visual coding, safe internet use, and everyday digital tools.

steps.title: Connect children to learning resources
steps.description: Children learn to find educational content, practise their school subjects, and explore new interests.

outcomes: Children gain confidence using computers and digital tools
Students can complete schoolwork and research independently
Communities gain a lasting space for digital learning
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: Children in underserved rural and urban communities who have little or no access to computers.

donationTiers.label: Digital workbook kit
donationTiers.description: Helps provide printed coding guides and learning materials for a child's digital skills sessions.

donationTiers.label: Monthly lab support
donationTiers.description: Helps run a series of facilitated computer sessions for a group of 15 children.

donationTiers.label: Community learning corner
donationTiers.description: Helps equip a community learning corner with refurbished laptops and offline educational software.

causeDetails.tagline: Curiosity grows when children get to build, test, and make things with their own hands.
overview: In many rural areas, science and mathematics are taught from chalkboards alone, with few chances to experiment. Hands-on learning makes abstract ideas click and sparks curiosity that lasts.
Our STEAM workshops bring practical activities in science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics to children who rarely get this kind of experience.

challenge.title: Limited hands-on learning in rural schools
challenge.text: Schools in remote areas often lack lab equipment, trained mentors, and project materials, so children have fewer chances to explore and discover their strengths.

steps.title: Bring portable labs to the village
steps.description: Facilitators travel to schools and village centres with portable science and maker kits needed for each session.

steps.title: Learn by making
steps.description: Children work in small teams on simple circuits, microscopes, bridge models, and creative experiments.

steps.title: Encourage questions & showcases
steps.description: Each workshop ends with children presenting what they built and explaining how it works to their peers.

outcomes: Children develop problem-solving, inquiry, and teamwork skills
Students show higher enthusiasm for science, math, and engineering
Rural schools gain reusable activity kits and teacher guides
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: School-age children in rural areas with limited access to science labs and hands-on learning.

donationTiers.label: Experiment kit
donationTiers.description: Provides hands-on science and maker materials for a student to take part in a workshop.

donationTiers.label: Full workshop session
donationTiers.description: Funds a full day of interactive STEAM workshops for a classroom of 30 students.

donationTiers.label: Rural school STEAM box
donationTiers.description: Equips a village school with a permanent multi-grade science and mathematics experiment kit.

causeDetails.tagline: When children can't get to books, we bring the books to them.
overview: Reading is the foundation of all other learning, yet many children live far from a library or have no storybooks at home.
The Mobile Library Initiative travels to underserved communities with vibrant bilingual books, storytelling sessions, and reading games, so reading becomes part of everyday life.

challenge.title: Too few storybooks within reach
challenge.text: Children without regular access to age-appropriate books fall behind in reading comprehension and find it harder to enjoy school.

steps.title: Visit on a weekly schedule
steps.description: Our mobile library van and bicycle librarians visit each community every week so children look forward to book day.

steps.title: Share stories aloud together
steps.description: Interactive read-alouds and puppetry sessions help young children enjoy stories and build vocabulary.

steps.title: Lend books to take home
steps.description: Every child borrows books free of charge to read at home with siblings and parents.

outcomes: Children read more frequently and develop a lifelong love for books
Families gain free access to bilingual storybooks and encyclopedias
Communities build a regular, shared reading culture
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: Children in remote or underserved neighborhoods who live far from a library.

donationTiers.label: 5 Storybooks
donationTiers.description: Adds five durable, illustrated bilingual storybooks to the mobile library collection.

donationTiers.label: Storytelling circle
donationTiers.description: Funds a month of weekly read-aloud and literacy sessions in a village.

donationTiers.label: Community book trunk
donationTiers.description: Establishes a rotating trunk of 150 books for an underserved neighborhood.

causeDetails.tagline: Creating something and watching it grow teaches children patience, teamwork, and pride.
overview: Art and gardening give children room to express themselves and learn through doing. They also build care for the natural environment and for one another.
Art & Gardening for Empowerment combines creative painting and craft sessions with organic school kitchen gardens, helping children grow in confidence while learning about ecology and nutrition.

challenge.title: Few chances for creative, outdoor learning
challenge.text: Many children in dense or underserved areas have little opportunity to express themselves artistically or learn hands-on environmental stewardship.

steps.title: Create together
steps.description: Children take part in weekly art, mural painting, and craft sessions that nurture imagination and emotional expression.

steps.title: Plant and care for a garden
steps.description: Students plant native seedlings and vegetables, compost organic waste, and observe plant life cycles firsthand.

steps.title: Share the harvest & exhibition
steps.description: Children showcase their artwork to parents and share fresh garden produce in school meals.

outcomes: Children gain creative confidence and collaborative teamwork skills
Students develop practical awareness of nutrition, soil, and ecology
Schools and communities gain vibrant green spaces they sustain together
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: Children who benefit from creative expression, nature connection, and outdoor hands-on learning.

donationTiers.label: Seeds & art kit
donationTiers.description: Provides organic seeds, child-safe garden tools, paints, and sketchbooks for a student.

donationTiers.label: Group eco-workshop
donationTiers.description: Funds a series of art and composting workshops for a learning center.

donationTiers.label: School kitchen garden
donationTiers.description: Sets up raised garden beds, drip irrigation, and art easels for a community school.

causeDetails.tagline: A notebook and a school bag can be the difference between attending class and staying home.
overview: For many daily-wage families, the cost of notebooks, uniforms, geometry boxes, and school bags is a real barrier. Children without these basics often feel left out or drop out.
School Supplies for Every Child provides complete, high-quality learning kits at the start of every school year so students walk into class prepared and proud.

challenge.title: Basic supplies are out of reach for many families
challenge.text: When families cannot afford school essentials at the start of term, children fall behind from day one or stop attending altogether.

steps.title: Partner with local teachers
steps.description: We work directly with village schools and learning centers to identify every child needing a kit.

steps.title: Pack grade-specific supply kits
steps.description: Each kit includes a weather-resistant backpack, ruled and unruled notebooks, pencils, pens, a geometry set, and a water bottle.

steps.title: Distribute before term begins
steps.description: Students receive their kits ahead of the first day of class so everyone starts on an equal footing.

outcomes: Children attend class daily with all the materials they need to write and draw
Families experience immediate financial relief at the start of the academic year
Students feel a strong sense of belonging, dignity, and readiness
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: School-age children from low-income families who cannot afford essential stationery and bags.

donationTiers.label: Stationery refill pack
donationTiers.description: Provides notebooks, pencils, pens, crayons, and a geometry box for one child.

donationTiers.label: Complete school kit
donationTiers.description: Provides a sturdy backpack, full year of notebooks, stationery, and a steel water bottle.

donationTiers.label: Sponsor 5 students
donationTiers.description: Equips five children with complete back-to-school kits for the entire academic year.

causeDetails.tagline: When a girl can learn, her whole community rises with her.
overview: Adolescent girls often face compounded barriers to education, from household responsibilities and financial constraints to a lack of safe transport and female mentors.
Girls' Education & Opportunity supports girls with study scholarships, bicycle/transport support, hygiene kits, and weekly mentorship so they graduate secondary school with confidence.

challenge.title: Girls face extra barriers to staying in school
challenge.text: Distance to secondary schools, cost of exam fees, and social expectations often pressure girls to leave school early despite their talent and determination.

steps.title: Provide scholarships & learning kits
steps.description: Girls receive textbooks, exam fee coverage, uniforms, and study materials so cost never forces them out of class.

steps.title: Lead weekly mentorship circles
steps.description: Trained female mentors guide girls in goal-setting, financial literacy, health awareness, and career planning.

steps.title: Engage parents as champions
steps.description: Regular family meetings build community pride and support for girls pursuing higher education.

outcomes: Over 96% of enrolled girls continue into upper-secondary education
Girls gain self-confidence, leadership skills, and clear career pathways
Mothers and fathers become vocal advocates for girls' education in their villages
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: Adolescent girls from underserved communities who need scholarships and mentorship to finish school.

donationTiers.label: exam & book pack
donationTiers.description: Covers exam registration fees and reference guides for a secondary school girl.

donationTiers.label: Mentorship & study support
donationTiers.description: Funds a term of after-school tutoring and leadership circles for a group of girls.

donationTiers.label: Annual girl scholarship
donationTiers.description: Supports a girl's full year of books, supplies, safe transport, and mentorship.
